prompt:
Our on-call SRE team needs to quickly archive all critical incident logs from the application log store at /workspace/app_logs into /workspace/archive/. A critical incident log is defined as any .log file that actually contains the word CRITICAL somewhere in its content — there are many log files in there, but only some of them are relevant.

Once the archival is done, we need a machine-readable inventory file called archive_manifest.json placed somewhere in /workspace showing exactly which files ended up in the archive, including their file sizes. This will feed into our incident reporting dashboard.

Please handle this end-to-end: identify which logs qualify, copy only those into the archive folder, and produce the manifest.
